newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Oct weekly earnings rise 3.0 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Canada Oct weekly earnings rise 3.0 pct on year.

text.p: The preliminary estimate of average weekly earnings for Canadian workers in all industries except agriculture and fishing rose 3.0 percent in October from a year earlier to a seasonally adjusted C$592.64, Statistics Canada said on Friday.
From the month before, earnings rose 1.0 percent.
Seasonally adjusted payroll employment rose 0.3 percent in October to 10.90 million from a revised 10.87 million (10.85 million) in September.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast that average weekly earnings would rise by 2.6 percent, year on year, after a 1.8 percent rise in September.
